_comment: Switch user, native emtk window. Drawn by emtk.view_form over SwitchUserModel (model.py): 'login' is the form of the Qt login dialog (server or MMFDB URL, port, account, password, the two remember options, Login / Cancel, status), 'notice' the message box the Qt dialog showed. The two editable combos of the Qt dialog are a text field plus a picker over the list.
title: Switch User

sections.title: Sign in
sections.name: login
sections.description: Sign in to the MMFDB workspace as another account.

sections.label: Server
sections.description: Host name or address of the MMFDB server. Type one, or pick a remembered server below.

sections.label: MMFDB URL
sections.description: Address of the remote MMFDB (an http or https URL).

sections.label: Port
sections.description: Command port of the MMFDB server (1 to 65535). The publish port is the next one.

sections.label: Recent servers
sections.description: The servers you signed in to before, newest first. Picking one fills the server field.

sections.label: User
sections.description: The account to sign in as. Type any account name, or pick one below.

sections.label: Select user
sections.description: The configured account and the desktop accounts. Picking one fills the user field.

sections.label: Password
sections.description: The account's password. It is shown as stars and never stored.

sections.label: Save selected user
sections.description: Remember this account as the default one for the next start.

sections.label: Log in automatically when allowed
sections.description: Keep a session token in the operating system's credential store so the next start signs in without a password.
Sign in, or close without changing the active user.

buttons.label: Login
buttons.description: Authenticate against the MMFDB. On success the account and server are remembered and the window closes.

buttons.label: Cancel
buttons.description: Close without changing the active user.

sections.description: The result of the last attempt, or what to do next.

sections.title: Notice
sections.name: notice
sections.description: A message about the sign-in that has to be read before the window goes on.
